cc:Work.dc:title: FlexBox - FlexBook
cc:Work.dc:description:
Box with living hinge styled after a book.
If you have an enclosure, arrange the living hinge to be as close to your extractor fan as possible.
![Open](static/samples/FlexBook-2.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes FlexBook --recess_wall 1 --x 90 --y 40 --h 150 --latchsize 10 --thickness 3 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes FlexBook --recess_wall --x --y --h --latchsize --reference --labels
